title: To The Peak
description: A remake of the popular climbing game using only commands!
body:
Start the game from any level with the: 
```
/function peak:start
```
command.

This will give you a few minutes to start climbing and stuff before it rises. The Fog is really laggy so please fix this if you are going to mark it up. The sun screen and tokens can be given with the funtion commands too starting with:
```
/function peak:....
```
To effectivly climb, look at a white listed block shift and jump. It works for blocks like stone, ice(increases exhaustion faster), and others. The datapack works by cheching for if you are crouching and if there is a air block beneath you.

But again, I most likly won't update this again so feel free too.
